title: قالو ليك
headline: قالو ليك ما كيمشيوش؟ خطوط حمرين وبيضين كيمشيو
problem: خطوط حمرين وبيضين بقاو فالكرش من نهار ولدتي، وكلشي كيقول ليك ما كيمشيوش.

hook_card.text:
خطوط حمرين وبيضين بقاو فكرشك من الولادة؟
وقالو ليك ما كيمشيوش؟

shots.vo_line: من نهار ولدت وهاد الخطوط الحمرين والبيضين فيا… عادي، كاع اللي ولدو هكا. ماشي صحيح!
shots.h3_prompt: First the belly talks sadly with clear, natural mouth movement on every word (0-3 s). Then the alum stone answers grumpily with clear, natural mouth movement on every word (3-5 s); the others just blink. Then the Guttiva bottle hops once and speaks firmly with clear, natural mouth movement until the very end, as the belly looks up. The Guttiva bottle keeps its exact shape and label. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. shots.vo_line: هادشي ديال الوراثة. ماشي الوراثة. الكرش كبرات دغيا ف 9 شهور، والجلد تقطع من لتحت.
shots.h3_prompt: The oil bottle twirls the golden helix above its hand and talks smugly with clear, natural mouth movement on every word (0-1.5 s). Then it closes its mouth, its smug grin slips into an offended pout and the helix droops and wobbles. To the end it keeps fidgeting with a closed mouth: tapping its foot, shifting its weight, blinking and rolling its eyes. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: كون دهنتي من الشهر اللول، ما يخرجوش. بزاف دهنو من الشهر اللول وخرجو. الزيت كيبقى فوق، والجرح لتحت.
shots.h3_prompt: The baby-oil bottle talks nervously and fast with clear, natural mouth movement on every word, wringing its little hands (0-2.5 s). Then it closes its mouth, flinches and shrinks down with a squash, glancing anxiously left and right. To the end it keeps fidgeting: shuffling its feet, wringing its hands, blinking fast and breathing quickly. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: صبري، كيمشيو بوحدهم. الحمرين ما كيمشيوش بوحدهم… كيوليو بيضين.
shots.h3_prompt: The cream tube lowers its tea glass and talks poshly with clear, natural mouth movement on every word (0-2.5 s); the belly listens with a closed mouth. Then the belly looks down as one pink line on its tummy slowly turns pale white, its smile sinking into a worried pout. To the end the cream sips its tea smugly and the belly hugs its glass, breathing and blinking. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: ديري الشبة، كتشد الجلد. الشبة كتنشف وكتحرق الفوق، وما كتوصلش للجرح.
shots.h3_prompt: The alum stone scrubs the belly in small circles and talks grumpily with clear, natural mouth movement on every word (0-2 s). Then the belly winces, squeezes its eyes shut and leans away with a little shiver, while the alum closes its mouth and scowls. To the end the alum keeps scrubbing stubbornly in small circles, white powder puffing, and the belly keeps flinching and breathing. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: هكاك غاتبقاي، قبلي بيهم! ماشي صحيح.
shots.h3_prompt: The oil, alum, baby-oil and cream point at the belly and talk together with clear, natural mouth movement (0-2 s) while the belly shrinks. Then the Guttiva bottle lands a firm hop, the tea glass jumps, and the others flinch and fall silent. The Guttiva bottle speaks firmly with clear, natural mouth movement until the very end. The Guttiva bottle keeps its exact shape and label. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. shots.vo_line: قرينا أكثر من 2000 تعليق ديال الماماوات… وبزاف منهن سمعو نفس الهضرة.

الخط جرح لتحت، فين الكولاجين اللي كيشد الجلد تقطع. الزيت والكريمة كيوقفو فالفوق، حيت الجلد فالفوق بحال حيط. أنا خفيف، كندوز لتحت: أركان كيغذي ويرجع المرونة، فيتامين E كيعاون الجلد يتجدد، الألوفيرا كتبرد الحمورية، والخزامى كتهدن. هكا الجلد كيصلح راسو من الجذر.
أنا سيروم خفيف، كنوصل للجرح. 20 يوم الحمرين كيبداو يمشيو، و 60 يوم الحمرين والبيضين كيتمحاو.
shots.h3_prompt: The three pink drops slowly sink into the belly's skin and vanish with a faint shimmer, while the belly looks down at them. Then the pink lines across its tummy slowly fade paler, and the belly looks up with a growing, delighted smile and a small happy bounce. To the end it sways gently from side to side, breathing and blinking, smiling with its mouth closed. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. shots.vo_line: جوج قراعي، شهرين كاملين، ب 299 درهم بلاصة 398. التوصيل فابور، وكتخلصي غير ملي يوصلك.
